name: Price Method 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of pricing calculation method.

FORW.name: Forward Price
FORW.definition: Price will be calculated after the close of the dealing period. An investor, therefore, does not know the exact buy or sell price.

HIST.name: Historical Price
HIST.definition: Price is calculated at an earlier valuation point preceding the dealing period. An investor, therefore, knows the exact buy or sell price.
